# COR011 `assumed-size`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A dummy array is assumed-size (`a(*)`, `a(n,*)`).

## Why

An assumed-size array carries no extent for its last dimension: the procedure cannot check bounds,
whole-array operations on it are forbidden, and the compiler cannot verify the caller. Use an
assumed-shape (`a(:)`) or explicit-shape (`a(n)`) dummy instead. Procedures with `bind(c)` are
exempt: there an assumed-size array (e.g. `character(c_char) :: s(*)`) is the idiomatic C array.

## Reported

```fortran
real, intent(in) :: a(*)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real, intent(in) :: a(:)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR011] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR011` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
